title: BreedingR: variance components and breeding values by AI-REML and single step
description:
An R package for variance components by AI-REML, breeding values, accuracy and single-step genomics. It grew out of doctoral research as a place to try out a few ideas and put specific models into practice: reaction norms on an environmental gradient, indirect genetic effects in group housing, and residuals that carry serial correlation. The numerics are written in the package itself, in C++ compiled by R CMD INSTALL, with no run-time dependency.

Includes AI-REML for single-trait, multi-trait and AR(1)/CAR(1) residual models; a Gibbs sampler over the same designs; single-step genomics with the exact inverse, APY, Vecchia recursions, or markers as equations (ssSNPBLUP); metafounders; genotype and phenotype quality control; and selection-signature scans.
